title: Equilibrium Analysis and Modeling of Glucose-Insulin Dynamics
expert_review: Excellent problem for applying basic control theory to biological systems. It clearly demonstrates the transition from nonlinear ODEs to block diagram representations.
source: Biomedical Control Systems - Glucose Regulation Exercise
learning_objectives: Calculate equilibrium points for a set of nonlinear coupled ODEs
Translate mathematical state-space equations into a block diagram
Understand the impact of insulin concentration on glucose steady-state levels
Utilize integrators to represent system dynamics graphically
